text: The meeting highlighted PowerPoint difficulties slowing progress and raised concerns about unclear production costs, feasibility of the 25 Euro selling price, and uncertain cost estimates.
Kinetic energy was decided as the energy source for the device and rubber will be used for the casing.
An advanced chip will be used to support the display and audio functions, and the target selling price is set at 25 Euro per unit.
The team proposed choosing a single shape for the device, and ME and UI will proceed to design after the meeting while saving the current smartboard design.
